notes.title: Devlog #1 – A Cat in Egypt: The Beginning of the Ta-Miu Adventure! 🐾
notes.notes: [h2][b]Hey there! 🐾[/b][/h2][p]Starting today, I’ll be sharing monthly updates on the progress of my game “Ta-Miu”! To kick things off, here’s a brief update on the current stage of production.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45679445/8ff310642fb4b8f151d8b37ba5b15000e94379d4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]💜 [b]A few words about the project itself[/b][/h3][p]“Ta-Miu” is an action-adventure game with RPG elements, in which you play as an extraordinary cat named Ta-Miu, exploring the magical and mysterious world of ancient Egypt. Chosen by the goddess Bastet for a challenging mission — to save the Pharaoh and, in doing so, all of Egypt from the evil powers of the god Seth — Ta-Miu embarks on an epic journey. Along the way, she meets an unusual companion: Sahi the mummy, who will aid her throughout her adventures.[/p][p]The game features classic mechanics such as an inventory system, quest system, and skill system. The first two are already fully implemented and working smoothly, while I’m still developing the skill system — and it’s coming along nicely.[/p][p]You’ll also be able to trade with a mysterious merchant cat 😉, who happens to be an avid player of Senet — a genuine board game from ancient Egypt.[/p][p]The game already features the first puzzles and riddles — though I don’t want to reveal too much so as not to spoil the joy of discovery! Ultimately, I plan to include many more, with a wide variety in both form and difficulty.[/p][p]Right now, I’m focusing heavily on the visual side of the game. Very soon, I’ll begin working with a 2D artist to create a clear, atmospheric interface inspired by ancient Egyptian aesthetics. At the same time, I’m gradually replacing placeholders with final assets and starting collaboration with a 3D artist to bring the game’s characters and creatures to life.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45679445/dc2d2b3641b1912dfbf32494f2bdaca0a8c37632.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]✨ My main goal at the moment?[/b][/h3][p]To create a stable demo version that will let you experience the atmosphere of Ta-Miu, earn your trust, and — I hope — spark your curiosity for more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45679445/d4bf99ba0746922d2920d599c93bb5029530b5cf.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]👉 [b]And now, a question for you![/b][/h3][p]What are your expectations for an action-adventure game set in ancient Egypt, where the main heroine is a cat on a challenging mission? What would you like to see? What intrigues you?[/p][p]As an Egyptologist, I strive to make Ta-Miu not only entertaining but also a gateway to discovering real elements of Egyptian history and mythology. The game will include references to authentic beliefs, locations, and figures — all presented in an accessible and engaging way.[/p][p]If you have specific questions, or if there’s a particular theme, artifact, or storyline you’d love to see in the game — let me know! Maybe I can create something just for you. 😊[/p][p][/p][p]Every comment matters greatly to me — your suggestions can genuinely influence the game’s development. 🐱[/p][p][/p][p]You can find more story details about Ta-Miu on my social media, such as X and Instagram.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next devlog! 😊[/p][p][/p][p]Maronika[/p][p]Dreamincorn[/p]
